title: Chipperfield JET51AD 3-in-1 Self-Propelled Petrol Lawnmower – 51cm, 180cc
description_html:
One lawn, three ways to cut it. The Chipperfield JET51AD is a self-propelled 3-in-1 petrol mower that adapts to whatever your garden throws at it — collect for a tidy finish, mulch to feed the lawn, or side-discharge to power through long, wet or overgrown grass. With a wide 51cm (20") deck and powered drive, it's built to make short work of medium and large gardens.

Three mowing modes in one machine

Switch between all three as the conditions change:

  • Collect — clippings gather in the grass box for a clean, manicured finish, with a full-box indicator so you know exactly when to empty.
  • Mulch — fit the included mulch plug to cut clippings fine and return them to the turf, feeding nutrients and moisture back into the soil with no waste to dispose of.
  • Side discharge — throw clippings clear when tackling long, thick or damp grass, keeping the deck clear of blockages and letting you press on through rougher areas and paddocks.

Self-propelled power for bigger lawns

A reliable 180cc petrol engine drives a wide 51cm cutting deck, so you cover more ground in fewer passes. Self-propelled drive pulls the mower along at a steady pace, taking the effort out of larger plots and gentle slopes — ideal for lawns up to 1,800m².

Set your finish, start with ease

Six cutting heights from 25mm to 75mm are set from a single lever, so you can dial in a close cut or leave the grass longer through dry spells in seconds. The easy pull-start system reduces cord resistance for a smoother, more comfortable start, even after the mower's been in storage over winter.

Built to work, easy to store

A steel cutting deck stands up to season-after-season use, while a 65-litre canvas collector with a hard top keeps clippings contained. Foldable, adjustable soft-grip handles make the JET51AD comfortable to guide and compact to store, and operator-presence control stops the blade the moment you let go for added peace of mind. Backed by a 2-year domestic warranty, with free engine oil included to get you started.
